written for a much older version of the project (dbt 0.19) and was never updated when the version numbering scheme changed. **The guide's tox command is stale and would fail** with `ERROR: unknown environment 'dbt019-py310'`.

### Working equivalent today

Based on the current [`tox.ini`](tox.ini), the correct modern form of that command would use one of the four supported dbt environments, e.g.:

```shell
tox -e cov-init,dbt190-py310,cov-report-dbt -- plugins/sqlfluff-templater-dbt
```

(substituting whichever dbt version — `170`, `180`, `190`, or `1100` — you actually want to test against.)

c) as `SQLFLUFF_GITHUB_TOKEN`"*

But [`util.py`](util.py) — the script invoked by `make release` — reads `os.environ["GITHUB_TOKEN"]` (line 123), and also references `GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER` (line 121) with no mention of `SQLFLUFF_GITHUB_TOKEN` anywhere in the file.

A maintainer who follows the checklist literally will set `SQLFLUFF_GITHUB_TOKEN` and then hit a `KeyError` crash when the script tries to read `GITHUB_TOKEN`. The fix is to pick one name and make both files agree — either rename the env var in the checklist to `GITHUB_TOKEN`, or update the script to read `SQLFLUFF_GITHUB_TOKEN`.
